# 💬 获取帮助 / Getting Help

## 中文

遇到问题时，可以按以下优先级获取帮助：

1. **先查文档**：访问官网 [konglong87.github.io/anything-ai](https://konglong87.github.io/anything-ai/) 与 `README.md`。
2. **提交 Issue**：在仓库 [Issues](https://github.com/konglong87/anything-ai/issues) 中描述你的问题（建议用 Issue 模板）。
3. **联系维护者**：GitHub [@konglong87](https://github.com/konglong87)。

---

## English

When you need help, try these in order:

1. **Check the docs first**: Visit [konglong87.github.io/anything-ai](https://konglong87.github.io/anything-ai/) and read `README.md`.
2. **Open an Issue**: Describe your problem in the repo [Issues](https://github.com/konglong87/anything-ai/issues) (use a template if available).
3. **Contact the maintainer**: GitHub [@konglong87](https://github.com/konglong87).
